submission.natural_language_explanation: Fires on a negator token when the negation bears on an evaluative adjective, a gerund or obligation, or a past-tense contraction: ' not' before an adjective or gerund ('not nice/mean/shiny', 'not listening', 'asked not to tell'), "'t" in 'couldn't/didn't/wasn't' + verb, ' no' in 'no one', and ' hardly'/' barely'. It is strongest (about 0.7-1.0 of max) on ' not' before an evaluative adjective or gerund and on ' no' in 'no one'. It stays weak (below about 0.25 of max) on 'do/does not' + an ordinary verb ('know/like/want/believe'), 'is not a' + noun, quantifier negation ('not every/only'), existential 'no' ('no milk/time/water'), 'cannot', 'never', and 'doesn't/wouldn't/isn't' contractions. Two token-specific offshoots from the prior record still fire strongly: the 'im' piece of 'Narasimha' (about 1.0 of max) and ' of' in 'Section <number> of the ... Act' (about 0.8 of max).
